authority: owner 2026-10-08 verbatim 'approve set A plan', relayed by the Test Lead: set A, amendment 1 (typical 1,250 W), merged hotspot question, the 53-job panel on local or free CPU only, then the value checks (a)-(d). Cell-only, no full plate, no spend. Panel definition: cooling-spreader-panel-v2.json (#822 @ 561bee38) with set A's buyer parameters

stack.lid: isotropic effective k 3,000 W/mK (vapour-chamber class), 3.0 mm, 30 mm footprint
stack.limit: 85 C at the lid-side TIM2 interface

contexts.hotspot_question: warm_central_band and warm_outlet_band are scored as ONE question on the worse (higher interface peak) of the two maps

geometries: channel width 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5 mm x depth 3 / 6 mm; fin 0.3 mm; base 0.5 mm; cover 0.5 mm (6 designs)

controls: ZERO_LOAD (cell + lid at inlet temperature, no source: drift and energy <= 1e-6 W per cell)
UNIFORM_1D_STACK (uniform map: lid jump qt/k and TIM2 jump qR2'' against closed form, <= 0.05 K)
FOURIER_CONDUCTION (lid series against the pinned Elmer lid solve)
CONTACT_SIGN_ORIENTATION (interface = face + R2'' q, flux into the cell positive)
CONSERVATIVE_MAP_TRANSFER (the cell's applied heat from the series map vs the lid's bottom flux integral, <= 0.1 %)
jobs.refinement: the 6 difficult cases (3 widths x depth 6 x the two hotspot maps) at two extra rungs: cell axial cells 2x and 4x (0.15 / 0.075 mm, other directions at the reference resolution) with the lid series at 2x and 4x modes = 12
jobs.witnesses: 6 repeating-cell 3D coupled witnesses: the cell's solid with the TIM2 contact and the 3 mm lid stacked on its heated face in one conjugate solve, for the 3 widths at depth 6 under the outlet band and the 3 depth-3 designs under the central band; reported as the composed-vs-coupled peak difference

coupling: candidate-specific fixed point: lid series (exact 2D, Fourier-cosine, bottom q_b = (T_lid_bottom - T_face_spanmean(x)) / R2'') <-> cell CFD with the tabulated q_b(x) as a cosine series (60 modes) in the heated-patch expression; start from the h-model pre-solve; under-relaxation 0.5 on q_b; converged when the TIM2-interface peak changes <= 0.1 K and the L1 flux change <= 0.1 %; 20 iterations max, exhaustion is REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED
observer: max over the heated face of T_face(x, y) + R2'' q_b(x) (composed TIM2 interface), its location, both TIM jumps, die-side diagnostic peak, cell pressure drop and dp x flow, PG25/Re applicability
verdict: interval = observed refinement/coupling changes around the composed peak; entirely <= 85 C PASS, entirely > 85 C FAIL, intersecting UNRESOLVED (refined re-solve near the limit as before: resolution 3 for any case within 1 K)
value_checks_after: per stratum and for the merged hotspot question: (a) 0.20 <= PASS/resolved <= 0.80, (b) margin spread >= 5 K, (c) >= 1 design PASS in all four questions, (d) best design (lowest dp x flow among PASS, ties by margin) differs across >= 2 questions; plus the complete-feasible-design count
compute: local operator-host CPU only, OpenFOAM pinned image opencfd/openfoam-default@sha256:33fb575a...; every cell invocation's wall, CPU and attempt recorded; no automatic retry
